text: Code reviews are a vital part of software development. When a developer finishes writing a new feature or fixing a bug, another team member examines the code carefully before it is merged into the main project. This process helps catch bugs early, before they become expensive or complicated problems in the final product. However, the benefits go far beyond finding mistakes. Code reviews are also an excellent opportunity for knowledge sharing. Junior developers learn new techniques and best practices from more experienced colleagues, while seniors can gain fresh perspectives. Ultimately, regular reviews build a stronger, more collaborative team where everyone feels responsible for the overall quality of the code.
